decision.explanation: Both dates are valid and refer to two distinct self-titled albums by the band *Killswitch Engage*. The first, *Killswitch Engage* (2000), was released on July 4, 2000 (D1S1). The second, also titled *Killswitch Engage* (2009), was released on June 30, 2009 (D2S2). These are separate releases by the same band with the same title, which is explicitly allowed under the instruction that different artists (or in this case, the same artist over time) can legitimately release works with identical titles.
